subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB590. SR3's list - alphabet-name-1, ALPHABETIC, ALPHABETIC-LOWER, ALPHABETIC-UPPER, BOOLEAN, class-name-1 - is the set of ClassConditionModel rows carrying ClassOperandRule.UsageDisplayOrNational, and NUMERIC is deliberately absent from it because SR8 states the same rule with a category escape. The predicate reads the operand's OPERAND picture (DataItem.OperandPic), so a bit or national GROUP answers as the elementary item 13.18.29.4 GR1b/GR2b makes it; a null picture is an ordinary alphanumeric group or a picture-less leaf and fails OPEN, which is the direction a screen must fail. Measured: `01 BT PIC 1(4) USAGE BIT. IF BT IS BOOLEAN` draws COBOL2202 where it previously compiled. The rule has no edition axis - the class condition and every alternative in its list except BOOLEAN exist at COBOL-85, and BOOLEAN is unreachable as a keyword below 2002 because it is not a reserved word there.
